market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: US-Iran are reportedly close on a one-page MOU that would lift US sanctions in exchange for nuclear enrichment moratorium, but Iran has stated enrichment is non-negotiable. The MOU itself may declare end of war and start 30-day negotiation; resolution requires definitive sanctions agreement, not openness/talks. Substantial sticking points remain. Probability of definitive agreement by May 31 is moderate but below 50%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether MOU itself triggers Yes vs requires more formal agreement; Iran's enrichment stance
